title: Baltic Coast · Kühlung Hills · Wismar
slogan: A 117 km loop out of Bad Doberan minster roads
story: Salt air first, soft hills after coffee. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 47 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Bad Doberan minster roads, Kühlungsborn beach road, Rerik cliffs photo stop, while the fuel checkpoint and the food stop keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.
